recipe.title: Pikelets
recipe.notes: This is Amy's Mum's recipe from a Sacred Heart cookbook.

method.s: Beat eggs and sugar, then add melted butter.
Sift flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt together, then beat into other ingredients until thick and creamy. If too thick, add a little cold water.
Cook on greased griddle iron, taking care not to burn.
Put on tea-towel or plate and keep covered.
